content.name: Olivia Nakamura
content.title: UX Designer
content.summary: UX designer with eight years across agency, superannuation and travel technology in Sydney. Specialises in complex forms and self-service, and my redesign of a super fund's rollover journey lifted digital completions by 38% while cutting call centre contacts.

experience.title: Junior UX Designer
bullets: Created wireframes and prototypes for government, retail and not-for-profit clients, working in small agency teams.
Ran remote usability sessions for a council service finder, leading to a simpler search used by residents across 12 suburbs.
Tested prototypes against the Digital Service Standard criteria on two state government projects.

experience.title: UX Designer
bullets: Designed member self-service for a super fund with 210,000 members, including contribution and beneficiary updates.
Redesigned the rollover journey, raising digital completions by 38% and reducing related call centre contacts by about a fifth.
Worked with legal and compliance to make disclosures readable without losing required wording.
Introduced card sorting and tree testing to restructure the member portal's navigation of 140 pages.

experience.title: UX Designer
bullets: Own the booking change and cancellation experience for a B2B travel platform used by 1,100 corporate travel managers.
Interview travel managers each quarter and turn findings into a prioritised opportunity backlog with the product manager.
Designed a self-serve refund tracker that cut 'where is my refund' tickets by 26%.
Mentor a junior designer and lead the team's monthly accessibility review against WCAG 2.2.

education.degree: Bachelor of Design in Visual Communication

achievements.title: Internal innovation award
achievements.detail: Rollover journey recognised as Coogee Super Fund's project of the year in 2022.

achievements.title: Meetup organiser
achievements.detail: Co-organise a quarterly Sydney meetup for UX designers working in financial services.
